evidence_scope: New synthetic segmentation supervision from frozen public reference lexicons. Partition by four physical leading keys before punctuation variants. New test families exclude the entire previously consumed public phrase-source vocabulary (including the boundary-v1 reserve and prefix corpus); the same lexical resources may know held-out words. This is not independent real-user intent or a new test of the unchanged context/prefix models. Fresh test opened only after sealing weights and a calibration-selected threshold. Old private/audit and published examples are regression cases, not held-out evidence.
